title: Causal verdict on legacy technical lineage routing
objective: Determine whether technical lineage is an independent routable transaction unit or primarily an input to accountable expert/service institutions.
truth_rules: HIGH INFORMATION VALUE != STANDALONE TRANSACTION VALUE
VALUABLE BECAUSE IT IS CONFIDENTIAL != LEGALLY ROUTABLE KNOWLEDGE
FOUNDER AS PERMANENT HUMAN SEARCH ENGINE = FAIL

findings.fact: Former-OEM expertise is economically real and is packaged by specialist service firms.
Mature expert networks already custom-recruit experts and operate confidentiality/conflict controls.
Former-employee knowledge can create trade-secret/confidentiality disputes when proprietary technical material is involved.
findings.caveat: Single US case; structural risk evidence only.

findings.fact: Reverse engineering, logic recovery and retrofit provide substitute recovery paths.

founder_dependence.reason: Standalone routing repeatedly recreates boutique lineage research, vetting, compliance screening and handoff without owning the service result.

missing_edge.reason: Technical lineage is a matching/ranking attribute inside existing expert/service transactions rather than a complete independent transaction unit.

preserve_as: future vertical-specific signal only where accountable service exists and lineage remains poorly indexed
